instructions: Create web-optimized derivatives from the approved final captures; keep the full-resolution App Store originals outside this website folder.
For each gallery slot, replace the child with class media-slot__frame with an img using class media-slot__image, the listed path and alt text, and loading=lazy plus decoding=async.
Keep each existing figcaption. Do not publish a media path until its file exists and the screen reflects the shipping app.
After all six gallery images are verified, change data-gallery-status on #preview from placeholder to ready; this swaps the status copy without changing the layout.

For the optional tour, replace the element with id tour-video-slot with a controls-enabled video using class tour-player, preload=metadata, playsinline, the listed poster and sources, and the English captions track. Do not autoplay audio.
After the tour and captions are verified, change data-tour-status on #tour from placeholder to ready; this swaps the status copy without changing the layout.
